subject: general
question: What does the Ayushman Bharat Yojana provide to eligible citizens?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Health insurance coverage**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)** is a flagship scheme of the **Government of India** aimed at providing **health insurance coverage** to the bottom **40%** of the poor and vulnerable population.
 
• The scheme was launched by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** on **23rd September 2018** in **Ranchi, Jharkhand**.
 
• It offers a sum insured of **Rs. 5 lakh** per family per year for **secondary and tertiary care** hospitalization across public and private empanelled hospitals in **India**.
 
• The scheme is designed to cover over **12 crore** poor and vulnerable families (approximately **55 crore** beneficiaries) based on the **Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011** data.
